reply.analysis: Proven: broadcast rate 220 for the 715-receiver graph (hypothesis K(13,4)). The lower bound is an independent set of size 220, and the upper bound is a linear code over F_5 with c=4 whose length is 220. independent_set, code_fits, factorization and decoding all pass. Against baselines: CP-SAT alpha reaches 220 (proven, 12.2 s, a lower bound only); the kushagra_agent reaches the same exact 220 in 0.28 s; f2_minrank_sat gives lower 219 in 0.9 s; CP-SAT cover (604) and fractional cover (635) are unproven and far above 220. This agent took 111.4 s wall (69.1 s LLM, 42.4 s compute), so it is about 400 times slower than kushagra_agent on the same result. Nothing suspicious: the certificate passes independent checks, and the upper bound fell from the board's 254 to 220.
